license_files.says: CCEL Copyright Policy: "Most of the editions ... are based on books that are public domain in the United States ... These books may be used for personal, educational, or non-profit purposes. Contact us for permission to republish CCEL works or to use them commercially."
ThML header: DC.Rights "Public Domain"; editorialComments "Some Roman numerals changed to Arabic and some spelling modernized."; print source not stated

flags.text: Digitization rights: the ThML header marks the text "Public Domain" (Beveridge died 1863; the 1845 translation is public domain), but CCEL's site policy limits its editions to personal, educational or non-profit use and asks for permission to republish or use commercially, and the header does not name the print edition that was transcribed. A clean redistributable Beveridge text needs either CCEL's permission or a separately provenanced digitization.
flags.resolves_by: Ask CCEL for permission for this edition; or identify the 1845/1846 Calvin Translation Society print volumes on the Internet Archive and produce or locate an independent transcription. This remains the primary Institutes artifact; the Allen translation (S75) is the second translation, not a replacement.

upstream_dependencies.source: Henry Beveridge, Calvin Translation Society, Edinburgh 1845-1846

steward_proposal.rationale: The named edition (Beveridge 1845) is on the NAS with its header and CCEL's policy page, but CCEL's non-commercial edition policy and the unstated print source keep it out of redistribution until resolved.
